items.question: What does a digital consultation actually include?
items.answer: A structured review of your online business — website, checkout, trust signals, and overall digital setup. You receive a written report with clear, specific recommendations you can act on immediately.

items.answer: No. We do not guarantee approval from Stripe, PayPal, or any payment processor. We improve your website's professionalism and trust signals — which supports payment review — but all approval decisions are made independently by the payment processors.

items.answer: Consultation packages range from 30 to 90 minutes, with written reports delivered within 24 to 48 business hours. The Elite Launch Package (full website build) typically takes 5 to 10 business days.

items.question: Can you build my website from scratch?
items.answer: Yes. The Elite Launch Package includes a complete website design and build. Other packages provide consultation and a written action plan you can implement yourself or hire us to execute.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Consultation services are non-refundable once the session has been conducted or the report delivered. Cancellations requested within 24 hours of purchase are reviewed on a case-by-case basis. See our Refund Policy for full details.

faqPage.headline: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.subheadline: Clear answers about consultation deliverables, timelines, refunds, multilingual work, and what third-party payment platforms decide on their own.

items.question: What does a digital consultation include?
items.answer: A structured working session that reviews your online presence—site, key flows, trust signals, and constraints—plus written notes or a deeper report depending on the package. You leave with prioritized recommendations and realistic sequencing, not generic advice.

items.question: Do you guarantee Stripe or PayPal approval?
items.answer: No. DegiScaler does not guarantee approval from Stripe, PayPal, banks, or any processor. We help with clarity, documentation readiness, and trust signals, but final decisions belong to those third parties.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Consultation packages range from 30 to 90 minutes of live time as listed. Written deliverables follow based on package depth. The Elite Launch Package typically spans several business days of design/build work depending on responsiveness and asset availability—expect a range rather than an instant turnaround.

items.question: Can you build my website from scratch?
items.answer: Yes when you select the Elite Launch Package, which covers end-to-end design and build scope described in pricing. Other tiers focus on consultation, audits, and planning—you can implement internally or discuss custom build scope separately.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Digital consultations behave like professional services: eligibility depends on whether work has begun or written deliverables were provided. Completed sessions or delivered reports generally are not refundable. See the Refund Policy for the fair, written standard we follow.

items.question: What happens after I buy a package?
items.answer: You receive onboarding instructions—what to send, scheduling links where applicable, and how deliverables arrive. Nothing hidden starts billing beyond the stated package; broader build work waits until scope is confirmed.

items.question: Do you work with e-commerce businesses?
items.answer: Yes. We regularly review storefront clarity, checkout flow, policies, catalog presentation, and trust placement for product-led businesses.

items.question: Can I request Arabic, French, or English websites?
items.answer: Yes. We can deliver interfaces and content structures in the language you need, including full Arabic RTL layouts or French copy alignment, as long as scope and assets are agreed in writing. Only the DegiScaler brand name stays fixed in Roman characters.

items.question: What do I need before starting?
items.answer: At minimum: a clear business description, primary goal (lead gen, sales, validation), any existing brand assets, access or URLs we can review, and realistic timeline notes. Payment happens through our published checkout flow before active work begins.

items.question: Can you audit an existing website?
items.answer: Yes. Audits and UI/UX reviews examine what you already have, highlight friction, list prioritized fixes, and explain why each item matters for credibility or conversion.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.headline: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: DegiScaler LLC ("we", "our", or "us") describes—at a general level—how information may be handled when you use this website or engage our services. This summary is not legal advice.
privacyPage.legalDisclaimer: This page is for general information and should not be considered legal advice. Consult qualified counsel for your situation.

sections.title: Information we may collect
sections.content: We may collect details you voluntarily provide, such as name, email, business description, project notes, and similar fields submitted through contact flows or service purchases. Technical data like IP address, device type, or browser may be collected automatically by hosting or infrastructure providers.

sections.title: Contact form data
sections.content: If you use a website form, the fields you submit are used only to respond to your request or to route you to the right service. Until a secure backend is connected, avoid sharing highly sensitive information inside form fields and prefer email for confidential documents if your counsel advises it.

sections.title: Payments handled by third parties
sections.content: Payments are processed by third-party providers. We do not store full payment card numbers on our own servers. Those providers process transactions under their own terms and privacy policies.

sections.title: Cookies & basic analytics
sections.content: The site may use cookies or similar technologies for basic functionality or aggregated analytics (for example understanding traffic patterns). You can manage cookies through your browser; disabling them may limit some features.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.content: We use information to respond to inquiries, deliver purchased services, improve site reliability, protect against abuse, and communicate about active engagements. We do not sell personal data for unrelated marketing.

sections.title: How data may be shared
sections.content: We may share limited data with infrastructure, payment, or email-delivery vendors strictly as needed to operate the business. We do not share information for independent marketing by those vendors beyond their role as processors.

sections.title: Data retention
sections.content: We retain business records and client communications only as long as needed to deliver services, meet legal obligations, or resolve disputes. Exact periods can depend on the type of record and applicable requirements.

sections.title: Security
sections.content: We apply reasonable safeguards appropriate to a small services business, but no online system is perfectly secure. You share information at your own considered risk.

sections.title: Your rights & requests
sections.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete certain personal data. Contact us using the email below and we will respond in a reasonable timeframe.

sections.title: Changes
sections.content: We may update this policy as practices evolve. Material changes will be reflected by updating the date above and posting the revised text on this page.

sections.content: Questions about privacy practices: support@degiscaler.com
